explication: Roslyn is the .NET Compiler Platform: C# and Visual Basic compilers plus APIs for code-analysis tools. A representative workflow starts with source text in a workspace document, obtains syntax and semantic information, and exposes compiler and workspace APIs to tools; analyzer/code-fix and IDE services are major adjacent capabilities. The excerpts and SOURCE INDEX support only some internal links, so unverified workflow links are dashed. The README documents the product scope, but does not describe detailed runtime wiring.
